max_dd.text_en: 5% trailing from the highest end-of-day equity. Intraday highs do not update it; the floor locks when it reaches initial capital.

daily_dd.text_ja: 3%。前日の終了時有効証拠金を基準に日次の下限を設定。現在の含み損益も判定対象。
daily_dd.text_en: 3%. The daily floor is based on prior-day closing equity; current floating P/L is also included in the test.

leverage.text_ja: FX30倍／指数・商品10倍／暗号資産1倍

consistency.text_ja: 出金時、最大利益日の利益が総利益の20%以下。超えた場合は追加利益が必要。
consistency.text_en: At payout, best-day profit must be at most 20% of total profit. Additional profit is needed if exceeded.

payout_limit.text_ja: 最低出金額は口座資金の1%。

funded_profit_target.text_ja: 合格後の利益目標なし。出金の利益日・一貫性等の条件は別途適用。
funded_profit_target.text_en: No funded-stage profit target. Profitable-day, consistency and other payout conditions apply separately.

ea.text_ja: 自分で管理する自動売買の条件付き利用。第三者製・共有・レンタルEA、価格遅延等を狙う自動売買は禁止。Instantでは自分が所有・開発したEAに限られます。
ea.text_en: Self-managed automation is conditionally allowed. Third-party, shared or rented EAs and automation exploiting price delays are prohibited. Instant permits only EAs you own and develop.

copy.text_ja: 自分の口座同士も含め、コピー・ミラー取引、シグナル共有、協調取引は禁止。
copy.text_en: Copy/mirror trading, signal sharing and coordinated trading are prohibited, including between your own accounts.

vps.text_ja: VPN・VPSは条件付き。地域制限の回避や、他者と連携した取引を可能にする共有環境は禁止。
vps.text_en: VPN/VPS use is conditional. Circumventing geographic restrictions or sharing environments enabling coordinated trading is prohibited.

ip.text_ja: IP・端末・接続環境と取引パターンを審査。VPNで所在地を偽る行為や口座共有は禁止。
ip.text_en: IP, device, connection environment and trading patterns are reviewed. Misrepresenting location via VPN and sharing accounts are prohibited.

payout_interval.text_ja: 標準は14日間隔。初回は最低5利益日、2回目は3利益日、3回目以降は利益日数の最低条件なし。評価型は週次オプションあり。
payout_interval.text_en: Standard interval: 14 days. At least 5 profitable days for the first payout, 3 for the second, and no minimum profitable-day count from the third. Evaluation models offer a weekly add-on.

minimum_profit_days.text_ja: 利益日＝その日の利益が初期資金の0.5%以上。初回出金5日、2回目3日。評価通過の最低取引日数とは別条件。
minimum_profit_days.text_en: A profitable day earns at least 0.5% of initial capital. Five are required for the first payout and three for the second. This is separate from minimum evaluation trading days.
